findings.title: Empty _validateSwap() in SolidlyV3AMO Allows Wrong-Direction Operations
findings.description: The validateSwap modifier in MasterAMO is the primary gate on permissionless mintSellFarm() and unfarmBuyBurn(). It calls _validateSwap(bool boostForUsd), which SolidlyV2AMO correctly implements with a reserve ratio check (lines 380-386). However, SolidlyV3AMO overrides it with an empty body: function _validateSwap(bool boostForUsd) internal view override {}. This means NO pre-condition check exists before public functions execute in V3 deployments.

findings.title: Hardcoded Slippage Min=1 in V3 Public Functions Enable Sandwich Attacks
findings.description: All permissionless V3 operations pass hardcoded minimum values of 1 for ALL slippage parameters: minUsdAmountOut, minBoostSpend, minUsdSpend, minBoostRemove, minUsdRemove, minBoostAmountOut. This provides effectively zero slippage protection. Any MEV bot can sandwich every public rebalancing transaction.
findings.max_economic_impact: 10-50% of each rebalancing trade; $10K-$100K+ per event

findings.title: boostPrice() Uses Flash-Loan Manipulable Spot Price for Critical Branching
findings.description: boostPrice() is used for the critical addLiquidity branching decision (MasterAMO line 212) and post-operation price checks (lines 288, 306). V2 uses IPair.getAmountOut() (spot price) and V3 uses slot0().sqrtPriceX96 (spot price) — both trivially manipulable via flash loans. Notably, the V2 IPair interface exposes a TWAP function current() that is NOT used.

findings.title: V2 Public Functions Use Spot-Price Params Enabling Sandwich Attacks
findings.description: V2 public _mintSellFarm() and _unfarmBuyBurn() compute all parameters from live on-chain reserves. While the swap portion has partial protection (minUsdAmountOut = 1:1 peg floor), the addLiquidity step passes minBoostSpend=1 and minUsdSpend=1 — effectively zero slippage protection on liquidity provision.

findings.title: V2 _unfarmBuyBurn() Circular Protection From Same Manipulable Reserves
findings.description: V2 _unfarmBuyBurn() derives ALL slippage protection parameters from the same pool reserves that a sandwich attacker manipulates. The minBoostRemove, minUsdRemove, and minBoostAmountOut are all calculated from current reserves — creating a circular dependency where the attacker controls both the attack and the 'protection.'
findings.max_economic_impact: Full unfarm operation value per transaction

findings.title: V3 _unfarmBuyBurn() Liquidity Calculation Uses Manipulable Spot Balances
findings.description: V3 _unfarmBuyBurn() calculates liquidity to remove using IERC20.balanceOf(pool) spot values. In V3 pools, tokens sent directly to the pool address change balanceOf() but not the pool's internal accounting. An attacker can inflate boostBalance by direct transfer, causing the protocol to remove excessive liquidity. Combined with min=1 slippage (VULN-017), the resulting operations are fully sandwichable.

findings.title: Uncapped BOOST Minting via MINTER_ROLE
findings.description: No supply cap on mint(). Compromised MINTER_ROLE can mint unlimited tokens.

findings.title: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Single Point of Failure
findings.description: Single address gets full admin control. No on-chain multisig/timelock enforcement.

findings.title: protocolMint() Has No Supply Cap or Rate Limit
findings.description: AMO_ROLE can mint unlimited uncollateralized BOOST. More severe than M-1 since no collateral required.

findings.title: setTokens() Can Redirect Collateral Flow
findings.description: ADMIN_ROLE can change token addresses instantly without timelock. Could redirect collateral to worthless token.

findings.title: setTreasury() Can Redirect All Funds
findings.description: ADMIN_ROLE can instantly redirect treasury address. No timelock or two-step confirmation.

findings.title: Initializer Front-Running on Proxy Deployment
findings.description: Proxy initialization can be front-run if not deployed atomically. Standard proxy pattern risk.

findings.title: Post-Operation Price Check Allows Value Extraction
findings.description: Post-operation checks use manipulable spot price, not average execution price. Sandwich within permitted band.

findings.title: withdrawERC20 Allows Unrestricted Token Extraction
findings.description: WITHDRAWER_ROLE can extract any ERC20 including operational tokens (LP, BOOST, USD).

findings.title: _mintSellFarm Uses Full USD Balance Including Pre-Existing
findings.description: Uses full balanceOf(address(this)) for addLiquidity, sweeping pre-existing USD into position.

findings.title: No Validation on boostLowerPriceSell/boostUpperPriceBuy
findings.description: SETTER_ROLE can set extreme price bounds, effectively disabling safety checks.

findings.title: Residual Approval to Router After _mintAndSellBoost
findings.description: Router approval not revoked after swap, inconsistent with _addLiquidity which does revoke.

findings.title: getReward() Sweeps Entire Balance Not Just Rewards
findings.description: Sweeps full balanceOf for each reward token, not just newly claimed rewards. Token overlap risk.

findings.title: setParams() Lacks Bounds on 5 of 7 Parameters
findings.description: 5 parameters have no bounds checking. SETTER_ROLE can disable safety mechanisms.

findings.title: block.timestamp+1 Deadline Provides No MEV Protection
findings.description: Deadline always passes since block.timestamp is set at execution time by block producer.

findings.title: V2 mintSellFarm Uses Entire USD Balance for addLiquidity
findings.description: V2-specific variant of M-9. Pre-existing USD swept with min=1 protection.

findings.title: V2 _validateSwap Uses Spot Reserves Enabling Manipulation
findings.description: Flash-loan can manipulate spot reserves to force or block AMO operations.

findings.title: V3 boostPrice() Manipulable slot0 + Potential Overflow
findings.description: V3 variant of H-3. Also has theoretical uint256 overflow for extreme sqrtPriceX96 values.

findings.title: V3 _addLiquidity Depends on Manipulable Pool Balance
findings.description: Liquidity calculation uses balanceOf(pool) which is inflatable via direct token transfer.

findings.title: targetSqrtPriceX96 Has Minimal Validation
findings.description: Only validates within MIN/MAX_SQRT_RATIO (near-zero to near-infinite). SETTER_ROLE can set extreme swap limits.

findings.title: V3 setTickBounds() Has Zero Parameter Validation
findings.description: setTickBounds() accepts any int24 values with zero validation. No check for tickLower < tickUpper, no tickSpacing alignment, no peg-proximity check. Worse than VULN-050 which at least checks MIN/MAX bounds. Invalid ticks DoS all V3 pool operations.

findings.title: Pause Can Freeze All Operations With No Guaranteed Unpause
findings.description: No on-chain recovery if UNPAUSER_ROLE key is lost.

findings.title: onlyContract Modifier Can Be Bypassed From Constructor
findings.description: code.length check is 0 during constructor. Still requires role.

findings.title: withdrawToken() Has No Token Restrictions
findings.description: WITHDRAWER_ROLE can extract any token. Low risk since Minter shouldn't hold tokens normally.

findings.title: setTokens() Doesn't Validate MINTER_ROLE on New boostAddress
findings.description: After token change, minting may revert if MINTER_ROLE not granted on new token.

findings.title: Integer Truncation in boostAmountIn Calculation
findings.description: Division before multiplication loses precision. Negligible economic impact.

findings.title: getReward passTokens=false Disconnects Gauge Claim From Sweep
findings.description: Token mismatch between gauge claim and sweep possible. Stuck tokens recoverable.

findings.title: Potential Underflow in _addLiquidity validRange Check
findings.description: If validRangeWidth > 100%, subtraction underflows. Requires SETTER_ROLE misconfiguration.

findings.title: Unsafe int256 to uint256 Cast in _unfarmBuyBurn Swap Result
findings.description: No explicit check that swap returned expected direction before negation and cast.

findings.title: Missing __gap Storage Arrays in All AMO Contracts
findings.description: No uint256[N] __gap arrays reserved for upgrade storage. Adding variables to MasterAMO in an upgrade would collide with child contract storage slots.

findings.title: Raw approve() Used Instead of safeApprove() in All AMO Approval Calls
findings.description: Both contracts import SafeERC20Upgradeable and use .safeTransfer() for transfers, but use raw .approve() for all 16 approval calls. Non-standard ERC20 tokens (e.g., USDT) that don't return bool from approve() would cause all AMO operations to revert. Current USDC+BOOST deployment unaffected.
